title: Merida China current warranty statement
notes: Current policy requires first-owner purchase through a designated authorized dealer, a valid warranty card and purchase proof; service is through the original dealer or a Merida store. Carbon frames are covered for the first owner's lifetime, derailleurs for 2 years, and listed general components for 1 year or the component maker's terms. Self-modified parts can invalidate coverage; unofficial online purchases are excluded. It does not establish the community build's invoice, owner, or authorized-dealer assembly history.
